reviews.text: This essence is a game-changer for my sensitive skin. It’s incredibly lightweight, absorbs almost instantly, and really helps calm down redness. I love the minimal ingredient list—just pure Centella. Perfect for daily use!
reviews.zh: 呢枝精華完全改變咗我嘅敏感肌。質地非常輕盈，幾乎即時就吸收，幫到手舒緩泛紅。好鍾意成分表好簡潔——純粹嘅積雪草。日常用一流！

reviews.text: I’m yet to know if this actually works.. it had such a strong medicinal smell I kinda put it down after the first use
reviews.zh: 仲未知呢枝係咪真係有用……藥味太重，用咗一次之後就放埋一邊。

reviews.text: This essence is incredibly calming and soothing. Whenever my skin feels red or irritated, this instantly brings relief. It has a watery texture that absorbs fast, leaving my skin hydrated without any stickiness. Perfect for sensitive skin and great for strengthening the skin barrier. Love it!
reviews.zh: 呢枝精華非常舒緩鎮靜。每當我塊面泛紅或者受刺激，搽完即時舒服返。水狀質地吸收快，保濕得嚟完全唔黏笠。敏感肌必備，仲有助強化皮膚屏障。好鍾意！

reviews.text: I have sensitive skin prone to redness, and this essence has been a lifesaver. The texture is light but hydrating, and it instantly calms any irritation or heat on my skin. I’ve been using it daily and noticed a big improvement in how calm and balanced my skin feels. Highly recommend for anyone with reactive or sensitive skin!
reviews.zh: 我係容易泛紅嘅敏感肌，呢枝精華簡直救星。質地輕但保濕，即時舒緩到我嘅刺激同發熱感。每日都用，覺得皮膚明顯穩定咗、平衝咗。強烈推薦畀任何容易反應或者敏感肌嘅人！

reviews.text: Ha sido una de mis favoritas, tengo la piel sensible y se irrita fácilmente. Por ello este producto me ha ayudado en mucho al calmar mi piel y disminuir la irritación y molestias. Incluso la he usado en mis sobrinos que son niños cuando han tenido quemaduras de sol y disminuye el ardor. Excelente producto
reviews.zh: 呢枝係我嘅最愛之一，我皮膚敏感又容易受刺激。所以呢個產品幫咗我好多，可以鎮靜皮膚，減少刺激同不適。我連細路仔姪仔曬傷嗰陣都用，幫到手減低灼熱感。產品好正。

reviews.text: Absolutely love this brand and the pure high quality ingredient. It's really soothing and hydrating so that I don't even have to use toner or serum with it. If you are after a good cica essence, this is the one I would recommend.
reviews.zh: 非常鍾意呢個品牌同佢純粹高質嘅成分。真係好舒緩、好保濕，用完甚至唔使再配合化妝水或者精華。如果你搵緊一枝好嘅 cica 精華，呢枝就係我會推薦嘅。

reviews.text: Al comprar la esencia me vino de regalo el tónico en versión pequeña, me encantó, como deja mi rostro así que tuve que comprar la versión grande, muy bueno, buenísimo. De los mejores tónico que e comprado
reviews.zh: 買精華嗰陣送咗枝細裝嘅爽膚水，試完覺得好正，搽完塊面嘅效果好好，所以要再買大裝，非常好，超讚。買過嘅爽膚水入面屬於最頂級嗰批。

reviews.text: So cute and tiny. I'm gonna be honest, I originally bought it for the bear. But this product genuinely works so well!! I naturally have super rosy cheeks (not rosacea or eczema) and it calms down the pinkness so well. I need this in a bigger size ASAP!!
reviews.zh: 好得意好細枝。老實講，我本來係因為隻熊先買嘅。但呢個產品真係好好用！！我本身面珠好紅（唔係酒渣鼻或者濕疹），用完泛紅即刻退好多。好想快啲有大裝！！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
